name: Unnecessary Comparison to Boolean Value
hint: This smell identifies a Boolean expression compared with true or 1, or with false or 0. The extra comparison makes the logic harder to read without changing its meaning.
instruction: Use the Boolean expression directly when comparing it with true or 1. For false or 0, negate the expression with [not < >] instead.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <<touching (Sprite2 v) ?> = [true]> then
say [Touching]
end
